scope: S02 General/Brand/Storefront/Localization settings desktop acceptance against the frozen S02 contract (descriptor settings.general-storefront)

cases.name: Login establishes an admin session
cases.expectation: login succeeds and the S02 settings panel renders

cases.name: S02 page is available
cases.expectation: /dashboard/settings/general-storefront renders 通用店面设置 with the settings.general-storefront.v1 descriptor badge

cases.name: Read-only actor sees no write controls
cases.expectation: read-only profile renders 只读模式 with no 创建草稿 control and no publish capability

cases.name: Create a structurally valid business-invalid draft succeeds
cases.expectation: a logoMediaRef pointing at a missing media id is accepted as a draft (no client pre-rejection)

cases.name: Server blocker persists the draft as invalid
cases.expectation: validate reports 验证未通过 with a blocker and the draft status becomes invalid

cases.name: PATCH corrects the invalid draft
cases.expectation: clearing the missing media ref saves the draft with a bumped version

cases.name: Revalidate the corrected draft as validated
cases.expectation: validate reports 验证通过 with no blockers

cases.name: Safe diff shows the exact public value change
cases.expectation: diff table lists field-path changes with public sensitivity and zero secrets

cases.name: Publish executes and returns a generation
cases.expectation: publish succeeds with a positive generation and the draft leaves the open list

cases.name: Public Storefront shows the published changes
cases.expectation: /storefront/config returns the published siteDisplayName and announcement, and the SiteHeader displays them

cases.name: EN and fr locales with fallback
cases.expectation: en-CA and fr-CA projections serve; unsupported locales fall back to en-CA

cases.name: Media/CMS/Dealer references resolve in the public projection
cases.expectation: published logoMediaRef, CMS refs and dealer/location refs resolve to public-safe objects

cases.name: Missing references degrade without breaking the public site
cases.expectation: a missing media ref yields degraded projection state while the storefront still renders

cases.name: Stale version yields VERSION_CONFLICT
cases.expectation: a stale expectedVersion yields a controlled 409 VERSION_CONFLICT

cases.name: Illegal state yields SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT
cases.expectation: publishing an unvalidated draft yields a controlled 409 SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT

cases.name: Malformed UUID yields a controlled 400
cases.expectation: a non-UUID draft id returns a stable 400, never a 500

cases.name: History is append-only with original publication facts
cases.expectation: published entries keep their original auditEventId and gains a superseded entry

cases.name: Rollback creates a new draft from the current publication
cases.expectation: rollback-draft returns a rollback_draft with rollbackOfPublicationId set

cases.name: Rollback publish restores the previous S02 version on the Storefront
cases.expectation: publishing the rollback draft yields a generation above the superseded one and the storefront shows the restored value (not generation 0)

cases.name: Fresh fixture serves compiled_default generation 0 and public fallback
cases.expectation: no S02 publication yields compiled_default generation 0 and the public site shows the compiled siteDisplayName

cases.name: Static export serves fallback then hydrates the published value
cases.expectation: a static server-mode load shows the compiled fallback first then the published value via the public API; an unavailable API keeps the fallback

cases.name: Audit safe snapshot carries real roles and no field values
cases.expectation: mutation Audit rows carry effectiveRoles/grants and metadata only with descriptorKey (no siteDisplayName/email values)

cases.name: Logout and post-logout state are clean
cases.expectation: logout returns to login and no protected settings state remains
